"""
Iteration-2 summary figure. All values are taken from the analyses already run and
saved in provenance/ (table5 apo control, site-2 geometry fit, table9 conservation,
AlphaFold AlphaMissense means). No value here is invented.
"""
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
OUT='/agent/jobs/5a541e70-d6f7-48b5-be7a-399123e44147/provenance'

apo=pd.DataFrame([("APOBEC3G-CTD 3IR2","active, apo",3),("AID 5W0R","active, apo",13),
    ("APOBEC3A 4XXO","active, apo",27),("APOBEC1 6X91","active, apo",66),
    ("APOBEC2 2NYT","inactive, apo",40),("APOBEC3A 5SWW","active, holo",3),
    ("APOBEC4 model","APOBEC4",35)],columns=["structure","group","clashes"])
geo=pd.DataFrame([("APOBEC4\nsite 1\nH93/C127/C134",[2.15,2.15,2.15]),
                  ("APOBEC4\nsite 2\nC28/C31/H34/C87",[2.41,2.41,2.41,2.41]),
                  ("APOBEC2 2NYT\nexperimental Zn",[2.23,2.34,2.14])],columns=["site","d"])
cons=pd.read_csv(f"{OUT}/table9_site2_conservation.csv")
am={'C28':0.922,'C31':0.937,'H34':0.916,'C87':0.943,'H93':0.885,'E95':0.916,
    'C127':0.945,'C134':0.931,'H65':0.511,'N124':0.317}
amgrp={'C28':'site 2','C31':'site 2','H34':'site 2','C87':'site 2','H93':'catalytic',
       'E95':'catalytic','C127':'catalytic','C134':'catalytic','H65':'substrate pocket','N124':'substrate pocket'}
COL={'site 2':'#2e7d32','catalytic':'#1565c0','substrate pocket':'#c62828',
     'active, apo':'#1565c0','active, holo':'#64b5f6','inactive, apo':'#757575','APOBEC4':'#2e7d32'}

fig,ax=plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(13,9))

a=ax[0,0]
a.barh(apo.structure,apo.clashes,color=[COL[g] for g in apo.group])
a.axvline(35,ls='--',c='#2e7d32',lw=1.2)
a.set_xlabel("ssDNA atoms within 2.8 A of protein (of 108)")
a.set_title("A. Control: the occlusion metric does not discriminate\nsame ssDNA, same zinc-anchor superposition, apo structures",fontsize=10,loc='left')
a.invert_yaxis(); a.tick_params(labelsize=8)

a=ax[0,1]
for i,(s,d) in enumerate(zip(geo.site,geo.d)):
    a.scatter([i]*len(d),d,s=90,color=['#2e7d32' if 'site 2' in s else '#1565c0' if 'site 1' in s else '#757575'],zorder=3)
a.axhspan(2.0,2.5,color='#ffe082',alpha=.5,zorder=0)
a.set_xticks(range(3)); a.set_xticklabels(geo.site,fontsize=8)
a.set_ylabel("donor atom to fitted metal centre (A)"); a.set_ylim(1.8,2.8)
a.set_title("B. APOBEC4 has a second geometrically assembled\nmetal site, 15.6 A from the catalytic site",fontsize=10,loc='left')
a.text(1,2.62,"4 donors, spread 0.00 A",ha='center',fontsize=8,color='#2e7d32')

a=ax[1,0]
cons=cons.sort_values(['element','position'])
a.bar(cons.position,cons.pct_identical,color=[COL[e] for e in cons.element])
a.axhline(62.8,ls='--',c='k',lw=1.2); a.text(0.1,65,"background identity 63%",fontsize=8)
a.set_ylabel("% identical in 233 vertebrate orthologs"); a.set_ylim(0,105)
a.set_title("C. The second site is as conserved as the catalytic site\n(98.3% vs 98.1%); the substrate pocket is not",fontsize=10,loc='left')
a.tick_params(axis='x',labelsize=8)

a=ax[1,1]
ks=list(am); a.bar(ks,[am[k] for k in ks],color=[COL[amgrp[k]] for k in ks])
a.axhline(0.435,ls='--',c='k',lw=1.2); a.text(0.1,0.46,"protein mean 0.435",fontsize=8)
a.set_ylabel("mean AlphaMissense pathogenicity"); a.set_ylim(0,1.05)
a.set_title("D. Human constraint follows the same split:\nmetal ligands constrained, substrate readers are not",fontsize=10,loc='left')
a.tick_params(axis='x',labelsize=8)

h=[plt.Rectangle((0,0),1,1,color=COL[k]) for k in ['catalytic','site 2','substrate pocket','inactive, apo']]
fig.legend(h,['catalytic zinc site','second metal site (new)','substrate pocket','inactive paralog'],
           loc='lower center',ncol=4,frameon=False,fontsize=9)
fig.suptitle("APOBEC4: the occlusion argument fails its control, but a second conserved metal site appears",fontsize=12)
fig.tight_layout(rect=[0,0.04,1,0.96])
plt.show()
